description: Independent SDK material words; D3D7 is additionally measured in d3d7_native_object_defaults.json. Float order is diffuse, ambient, specular, emissive, power.

sources.7: Original Microsoft system D3D7 RGB, two fresh devices after changing all material and plane words

notes: D3D8 white RGB/zero alpha differs from D3D7 and D3D9. D3D8/9 have not been measured using original Microsoft HAL here. Zero planes are measured for D3D7 and follow zero initialization/reset in Wine wined3d for D3D8/9. This reference does not assert shader constant Reset behavior.
